more_editor_launch_options: Plus d'options de lancement de l'éditeur
fetch_error: Impossible de récupérer les versions disponibles.
available_subtitle: Provenant des versions officielles de Godot.
current_set_desc: {{tag}} is now reachable through the alias below.
current_path_hint: Add the folder above to your PATH to run "Godot" from any terminal, script, or tool. The alias always follows the current version, so pinning another version or uninstalling this one updates it automatically.
current_shim_note: Windows symlinks need Developer Mode or admin rights, so a launcher script was created instead. It behaves the same from the command line.
aliases_desc: Create extra command names that point at a specific Godot version, so scripts, tests and tools can call them by name.
aliases_empty: No aliases yet. Pick a version above, give the command a name, and it will appear in the aliases folder.
aliases_no_versions: Install a Godot version first to create an alias.
aliases_path_hint: Add the aliases folder to your PATH to run these names from any terminal or tool. The "Godot" command from the current version pin lives in the same folder.
alias_remove_desc: The command "{{name}}" will stop working. The Godot version itself stays installed.
alias_mono_script_note: Mono builds load GodotSharp from the folder next to the executable, so on Windows the alias is created as a launcher script instead of a link.
mise_sync_title: Import the Godot versions mise has installed so they show up here.
mise_uninstall_desc: mise will uninstall {{tag}} from its own store. Projects that pin it in mise.toml will need it installed again.
export_templates_remove_desc: The export templates for {{tag}} will be deleted from disk. You can download them again later.
export_templates_orphans_desc: These folders don't match a Godot version managed by GodotHub.
export_templates_choose_desc: Choose platforms, architectures or individual files for Godot {{tag}}.
export_templates_options_failed: Couldn't load the templates for this release.
export_templates_keep_existing: Expand a platform to choose architectures or individual files. Only selected files are downloaded. Your existing templates are kept.
download_failed_desc: GodotHub n'a pas pu terminer l'installation de {{tag}}. Copiez les détails ci-dessous et partagez-les pour permettre le diagnostic.
download_failed_hint: Causes fréquentes : un réseau ou un proxy bloqué, un antivirus qui bloque le téléchargement, un dossier de téléchargement manquant ou en lecture seule, ou un espace disque insuffisant.
